evidence_basis: Project guidance identifies reaction impulses in T01 output.
The preserved CSV agrees with that interpretation across multiple subwindows (1000.000849 / 999.999664 / 1000.001765 N).

The controlled /TH/TITLE experiment leaves CSV output unchanged for the tested binary and invocation (byte-identical CSV, SHA256 a2b2d4ceab03731b2b373ada38e83828a8ba6c215ef968ad691b0dd533195dca, with and without /TH/TITLE).

observed_coarse_fixed.closure_residual_note: residual of momentum balance: applied impulse - (delta_J + delta_Pz); ~0.0000315% of applied impulse

reason: The frozen static estimator defined Rz as the time-mean of summed REACZ channels, assuming they carry force (N). The preserved CSV channels carry cumulative impulse (N.s). The time-mean of a cumulative impulse is its time-average, not a force; the corrected estimator differentiates.
scope: Establishes impulse output with and without /TH/TITLE in the tested configuration only. Does not establish the converter's behavior under every option or metadata arrangement. Implementation explanation remains open pending source inspection.
status: NOT_VERIFIED overall. This amendment corrects the measurement record; it closes no gate by itself.
